# Muvap

> Muvap is David Berrocal's independent RevOps and GTM systems consultancy. Muvap designs and builds the revenue operations infrastructure that connects sales, marketing and data: lead scoring, CRM architecture, lifecycle stages, automation, AI agents and reporting, mainly on HubSpot.

## Company

- [About](https://davidbervic.com/about.html): Who Muvap is, real client engagements (MEDLIFE, CloudTask), martech stack.
- [Services](https://davidbervic.com/index.html#services): GTM audit, implementation, and ongoing retainer.
- [Contact](https://davidbervic.com/contact.html): Book a call or message directly.

## Case studies

- [How MEDLIFE built its first reliable revenue funnel on HubSpot](https://davidbervic.com/case-study.html?case=1): Lifecycle unification, lead scoring, CRM governance and AI agents for a global nonprofit.
- [How CloudTask turned HubSpot into the revenue engine of a two sided talent marketplace](https://davidbervic.com/case-study.html?case=2): Pipeline architecture, custom objects, multichannel outbound and answer engine optimization for a B2B RevOps marketplace.
